camel_example: aliyun emr CreateScript --region cn-hangzhou --ScriptType BOOTSTRAP --Scripts.1 'example-string' --ClusterId 'c-b933c5aac8fe0000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --TimeoutSecs 'example-string' --method POST --force
description_en: Creates a bootstrap script or a regular cluster script
description_zh: 创建引导脚本或者普通集群脚本
kebab_example: aliyun emr create-script --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-id c-b933c5aac8fe0000 --script-type BOOTSTRAP --scripts '["example-string"]' --timeout-secs example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateScript

parameters.help_en:
The script type. Valid values:

BOOTSTRAP: an ECS instance bootstrap script.

NORMAL: a normal script
parameters.help_zh:
脚本类型。取值范围：
 
BOOTSTRAP：ECS实例引导脚本。
NORMAL：普通脚本
parameters.name: script_type

fields.help_en:
The execution failure strategy. Valid values:

`FAILED_CONTINUE`: If the script fails, cluster creation or scaling continues.

`FAILED_BLOCK`: If the script fails, cluster creation or scaling is blocked
fields.help_zh:
执行失败策略。取值范围：
FAILED_CONTINUE：失败后不阻塞集群创建或者阻塞集群扩容。
FAILED_BLOCK：失败后阻塞集群创建或者阻塞集群扩容
fields.name: execution_fail_strategy

fields.help_en:
The execution timing for the script. Valid values:

`BEFORE_INSTALL`: The script runs before applications are installed.

`AFTER_STARTED`: The script runs after applications start
fields.help_zh:
脚本的执行时机。取值范围：
BEFORE_INSTALL：应用安装前。
AFTER_STARTED：应用启动后
fields.name: execution_moment

fields.help_en: This parameter is deprecated. Use `NodeGroupIds` instead
fields.help_zh: 该参数已废弃，替换为NodeGroupIds参数
fields.name: node_group_id

fields.help_en: The IDs of the node groups to select
fields.name: node_group_ids

fields.help_en: This parameter is deprecated. Use `NodeGroupNames` instead
fields.name: node_group_name

fields.help_en: The names of the node groups to select
fields.name: node_group_names

fields.help_en: The types of node groups to select. This parameter applies only when `NodeSelectType` is set to `NODE_GROUP` and `NodeGroupIds` is not specified. The array can contain up to 10 elements
fields.help_zh: 节点组类型。当NodeSelectType取值NodeGroup，且参数NodeGroupId为空时生效。数组元数个数N取值范围：0~10
fields.name: node_group_types

fields.help_en: The names of the nodes to select. This parameter applies only when `NodeSelectType` is set to `NODE`
fields.help_zh: 节点名称列表。当NodeSelectType取值Node时，该参数生效
fields.name: node_names

fields.help_en:
The node selection type. Valid values:

`CLUSTER`: Selects all nodes in the cluster.

`NODE_GROUP`: Selects nodes by their node group.

`NODE`: Selects specific nodes by name
fields.help_zh:
节点选择类型。取值范围：
CLUSTER：集群。
NODE_GROUP：节点组。
NODE：节点
fields.name: node_select_type

fields.help_en: Specifies the criteria for selecting nodes
fields.name: node_selector

fields.help_en: This parameter is deprecated. Scripts run in the order they are defined
fields.help_zh: 此参数已废弃，脚本执行的顺序同脚本定义的顺序
fields.name: priority

fields.help_zh: 脚本执行参数。非必填参数
fields.name: script_args

fields.help_en: The required script name. The name must be 1 to 64 characters long and start with a letter or a Chinese character. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. It can contain Chinese characters, letters, numbers, underscores (`_`), or hyphens (`-`)
fields.help_zh: 脚本名称。必填。长度为1~64个字符，必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以 http:// 和 https:// 开头。可以包含中文、英文、数字、下划线（_）、或者短划线（-）
fields.name: script_name

fields.help_en: The required path to the script in Object Storage Service (OSS). The path must start with `oss://`
fields.help_zh: 脚本所在OSS路径。必填。以 oss:// 开头
fields.name: script_path

parameters.help_en: The timeout period for manually executing the script. This parameter is not supported for bootstrap scripts
parameters.help_zh: 手动执行脚本超时时间，不支持引导脚本设置
parameters.name: timeout_secs
